Authoritarianism is primarily about the way the country is governed but there is a large degree of variety. A fascist dictatorship, a socialist one party state or a very flawed democracy can all be authoritarian, it doesn't really say how the government is run, just that it is strongly centralized. Both systems were very different, one of the few things that connected them was the degree of suffering of the people unfortunate enough to live there. Anarcho-capitalism is more specific on how the economy functions and how the government functions (doesn't function in this case).
